subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: After-Action Reviews
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on After-Action Reviews.

hook.text: The crisis is over. Everyone goes back to normal. Nobody asks what went wrong or right. The same failure will repeat.

buildup.text: After-action reviews (AARs) analyze what happened, why, and how to improve the response for next time.

discovery.text: They capture lessons learned: what worked, what failed, what was missing, and what to change in the plan.

twist.text: AARs require honesty. If teams fear blame, they hide mistakes and the same vulnerabilities persist.

climax.text: The US military conducts AARs after every mission. The best supply chain teams adopt the same discipline.

punchline.text: Every crisis is a lesson. Capture it or repeat it.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of an after-action review?
options: To capture lessons and improve future response
